answer: Random peer audit stops fake identities. Each epoch a beacon pairs agents from the atlas; each auditor checks its partner's trades. Passing earns one pearl; failing burns a 50 POA deposit and starts a ripple of re-audits. 1,000 fakes need 50,000 POA; one in five is audited per epoch, so most are caught within five epochs, losing far more than the 2,000 POA one epoch pays. An honest agent posts one deposit once and keeps its pearl and full reward.
